list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them, 2026-11-18
note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation wording. Each guide is HEISTBOARD's own advice, built from the official description and labelled as not yet checked in-game. Sources per trophy: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles for the PSN count or target where one is listed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: This pops on its own once the other 54 are earned, so treat it as the finish line, not a task. Work the roadmap in order — story first with the missable mission trophies, then collectibles, then the activity grinds, with 100% completion last — and this one follows.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end — it is the first story beat, so this should be one of your earliest trophies. Flagged missable because it belongs to a single opening mission: if a step stalls, look for a mission replay in the pause menu before moving on.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission Chapter 1 offers and this pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies are progress markers: keep following the story icons on the map and do the side strands as they appear, not after the chapter ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission Chapter 2 offers and this pops when the chapter closes. Before you start the chapter, clear the Chapter 1 missables on this board — chapter trophies themselves cannot be missed, but the mission trophies inside a chapter can be.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission Chapter 3 offers and this pops when the chapter closes. Vice City opens up properly here, so use the chapter to knock out exploration and vehicle-discovery trophies while you are travelling between missions anyway.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission Chapter 4 offers and this pops when the chapter closes. By now the board should be mostly story-complete: check the missable lane before the final mission, because after the story ends some mission-only moments may not come back.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and this gold pops. Flagged missable because it is a single end-of-story moment: finish every other missable mission trophy first, and make a manual save before you start the finale so you can replay it if the game lets you.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. It is named in the official description, so it only comes around when the story offers it: play it the first time it appears, and check the mission-replay menu if you need a second run at it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces, so expect a multi-stage job: follow the on-screen objectives, keep your partner alive, and do not rush the escape — the trophy is for completing it, not for speed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it only arrives when the story offers that mission, so take it the first time it appears and save before you start it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. The name suggests a show or headline-grabbing job: expect a loud one, follow the mission markers, and remember this is a one-shot story mission, so it is flagged missable on this board.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. VCIA is the Vice City airport, so expect a vehicle or aircraft theft under pressure: grab the target, lose the heat, and deliver it where the mission points you.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. An operation name means a planned, probably military-flavoured job: stock up on armour and ammo before you start, follow the squad objectives, and treat it as a one-shot story mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the long grind and the second gold. Story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the percentage, so check the in-game stats page regularly to see what is still missing and work the biggest gaps first.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 250 stunts. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — PSN tracks the count to 250. Stunts build up across normal play: jumps, airtime, near-misses and drifts all feed the total, so drive fast and often instead of grinding one spot. Check the in-game stats page to watch the counter climb.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 9 activity types. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — PSN lists 9 types. Sample everything the map offers: races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling and the rest, one of each. The in-game activities menu shows which types you have tried, so work down that list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 42 Shooting Range challenges. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — PSN tracks the count to 42. Work through the range weapon by weapon and push each challenge to gold; practice the weapon types you are weakest with first, and use the range's own scoring feedback to learn what gold demands.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 14 drone race locations. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — PSN lists 14 of them. Visit each race spot on the map and win there; drone handling rewards smooth lines over raw speed, so learn a course with one slow lap before you race it for real.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 20 different races. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count, so spread out across the map. Pick the vehicle class each race suits, learn the route on a practice run, and tick races off in different districts so you are always covering new ground.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and win it: watch the bite timing, keep the line tension in the safe zone, and reel steadily instead of yanking. Losing costs nothing but time — challenge him again.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, start to finish. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; pick the shortest-looking game first, learn its controls in the first minute, and play to the end rather than chasing a high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last job in his strand. Do Andy's missions as they appear rather than stockpiling them, and save before the finale: a character's final mission is a one-shot story moment, so it is flagged missable on this board.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the last job in his strand. The name hints at a boat job gone sideways: keep a fast boat or a getaway vehicle in mind, finish his earlier missions first, and save before the finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the last job in his strand. A lone-rider finale sounds like a solo ride: keep your bike fuelled and your weapons stocked, clear his earlier missions first, and save before you start it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 8 stranger strands. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida — PSN tracks the count to 8. Stranger icons appear as you explore the map, so roam beyond the cities and answer every one you meet. Each strand is several missions long, so start them early and finish one strand before starting three more.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the last job in his strand. Supply-and-demand work usually means moving product under pressure: clear his earlier missions as they appear and save before the finale, because a character's last mission is a one-shot moment.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the last job in his strand. Work through his missions in order as the story offers them, and make a save before the finale so a failed attempt costs you minutes, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 18 meditation spots. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — PSN lists 18 spots. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places, usually marked when you get close: visit them during your exploration sweeps, meditate at each one, and tick them off on this board as you go.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Find Bret, take the hunt, and track the animal he names: move slowly, use cover and the right weapon for a clean kill, and follow the trail markers rather than wandering. The animal is unique, so the hunt only ends when you take that one down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 3 completed card sets. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — PSN tracks the count to 3. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect them district by district and check your collection menu to see which sets are one card short. Trade or buy the last card of a set before you grind a fresh district.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 100 WAiNK locations. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — PSN tracks the count to 100, the biggest collectible grind on this board. WAiNK spots are spread across the whole state, so fold them into every trip: hit the spots near each mission or race instead of saving all 100 for the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 50 challenges. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — PSN tracks the count to 50. Challenges cover driving, shooting, flying and more, so the counter climbs while you play everything else: check the challenges menu, clear the easy ones first, and leave the skill-based ones until your aim and driving are warmed up.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape. Flagged missable because it needs your partner present — do it while the story still pairs you up. Build the heat in a quiet area, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level — keep the heat the whole run. Flagged missable because it needs your partner: pick three shops close together, plan the route first, rob fast, and drive — do not stop to fight, or the wanted level drops and the chain breaks.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 100 discovered vehicles. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — PSN tracks the count to 100. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so sit in everything you pass: traffic, parked cars, bikes, boats and aircraft. Variety beats repetition — a new model counts, the tenth sedan does not.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 5 enemies in one Combat Focus. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a fight with a crowd — a gang shootout or a wanted-level chase — trigger Combat Focus when five or more enemies are in view, and work through them fast before the focus ends. If the crowd thins out, back off and try a busier fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Flagged missable because it is a one-off stunt at a specific place: grab an aircraft or a fast vehicle at the airport and leave in a way no schedule allows. Save before you try it, and expect security to object.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke and the fight is not: bring heavy weapons, use cover, and hit a Rhino from the sides or rear rather than head-on. Military areas and high wanted levels are where the tanks show up.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Flagged missable because one spotted attempt can spoil the run: case the store first, move quietly, take what you came for and leave before the alarm. If you are seen, reload your save and try a quieter approach.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 5 bank vaults. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — PSN tracks the count to 5. Plan each vault like a small heist: a fast car parked close, an escape route picked before you go in, and no lingering once the vault is open. Five clean escapes beat five messy ones.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida: stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat. A sticky bomb or a hard ram stops the truck; a fast car and a planned route get you away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 52 areas of Leonida. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — PSN lists 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map until each area registers: the in-game map shows what is still unexplored, so sweep district by district and finish the remote islands and swamps last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 9 gangs. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — PSN lists 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang across the map, hit it, and get out. Gangs hold different territory, so this trophy doubles as a tour of Leonida's roughest corners.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a sea view, order a cocktail, and take it in — this one is a breather between heists, and it pops when the moment lands.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car into a showroom, then floor it straight back out through the glass — the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom with a clear run out and a fast car, and expect the law to notice.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that alley, bowl a game, and follow through on your throw — the trophy is about the ritual as much as the score. If it does not pop on the first game, finish a full game rather than quitting early.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal. The official description is deliberately vague — it reads like a duo moment that the public notices — so keep playing the partner story and the social-media-flavoured activities together, and it should land as the partnership grows.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN tracks a count to 500 choices. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count to 500. Choices add up across the story and side content, good and bad alike, so keep deciding instead of stalling: the counter climbs over a full playthrough, and the in-game stats page shows how far along you are.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Succeed on the second try. Fail at something, then land it on the very next attempt — the trophy is for the comeback, not the failure. A race, a challenge or a stunt you miss once and nail immediately after is the natural way in.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd events off the beaten path — lights in the sky, things that should not be there — so explore the empty places: the swamps, the desert roads and the coastline at night, and keep your eyes open.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Cruise slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep moving. Pick a quiet street so you control the attempt instead of the police controlling it for you.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of $250,000 laundered. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — PSN tracks the total to $250,000. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies, so keep laundering them through your contacts after every big job instead of sitting on dirty cash.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of $100,000 spent. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PSN tracks the total to $100,000. Clothes, weapons, ammo, food and cars all count, so this climbs naturally if you gear up properly. Do not force it early: spend on things you will actually use, and the total takes care of itself.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN lists 8 garage properties. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — PSN lists 8. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida; save up, buy them one district at a time, and check your property menu to see which ones are still missing.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.sources: Exophase — official name, description and grade; PSNProfiles — PSN target of 10 registered vehicles. Guide: our own advice from the official description, not yet checked in-game.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PSN tracks the count to 10. Open the app, register the vehicles you own or find, and work up to ten different ones. It pairs well with vehicle discovery: register each new find as you go.
